description: Use this to keep only some already-verified external addresses on an inbox. Requires auth and inbox_update. Inputs: inbox_id (required), emails (required array). Each address must already be verified on this inbox. Pending addresses are left as they are. Addresses omitted from emails are removed. An address that is not verified is HTTP 400 forwarding_not_verified. More than 5 destinations, counting pending rows, is HTTP 409 forwarding_limit. Returns {object:"inbox_forwarding", destinations, unverified}. Does not accept or return a confirmation code. Forwards still use the send path and the monthly send quota.

emails.description: Verified external addresses to keep. Each one must already be verified on this inbox. An empty array removes every verified destination.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…), username, or full email address owned by this key

name: cooper_set_forwarding

outputSchema.description: The destinations after the verified list is replaced. No confirmation code.

destinations.description: Every destination still stored. No confirmation code.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object was created.

id.description: Stable id of the returned object. Pass it to the matching get, update, or delete tool.

object.description: Object type name, such as list, message, or thread.

verified_at.description: ISO-8601 time the address was confirmed, or null.

object.description: Object type name, such as list, message, or thread.

title: Replace verified auto-forward destinations
